pistol.name: Pistol
pistol.rules: A model making an attack with this weapon targeting a model it is in melee with ignores the Target in Melee bonus when resolving this attack.

continuousEffectFire.name: Continuous Effect: Fire
continuousEffectFire.rules:
A model hit by this attack suffers the Fire continuous effect.

A model hit by this attack suffers the Fire continuous effect , which sets it on fire. A model on fire suffers a POW 12 fire damage roll each turn during its controller’s Maintenance Phase until the continuous effect expires. Models with Resistance: Fire never suffer this continuous effect.

chainWeapon.name: Chain Weapon
chainWeapon.rules: Attacks with this weapon ignore the Buckler and Shield weapon qualities and Shield Wall ARM bonus.

throwPowerAttack.name: Throw Power Attack
throwPowerAttack.rules: This weapon can be used to make throw power attacks.

shield.name: Shield
shield.rules: This weapon is a shield that gives the model a cumulative +2 ARM bonus; for example, a model with two of them gains a bonus of +4 ARM. A model does not gain this bonus while the weapon system with the shield is crippled.

blessed.name: Blessed
blessed.rules: Attacks with this weapon ignore bonuses from spells, including animi, that add to a model’s ARM or DEF.

buckler.name: Buckler
buckler.rules: This weapon has an integral buckler that gives the model a cumulative +1 ARM bonus; for example, a model with two of them gains a bonus of +2 ARM. A model does not gain this bonus while the weapon system with the buckler is crippled.

weaponMaster.name: Weapon Master
weaponMaster.rules: When resolving an attack with this weapon, add an additional die to damage rolls.

criticalFire.name: Critical Fire
criticalFire.rules:
On a critical hit, the model hit suffers the Fire continuous effect.

On a critical hit, the model hit by this attack suffers the Fire continuous effect.

continuousEffectCorrosion.name: Continuous Effect: Corrosion
continuousEffectCorrosion.rules:
A model hit by this attack suffers the Corrosion continuous effect.

A model hit by this attack suffers the Corrosion continuous effect, which slowly erodes its target. Corrosion does 1 point of corrosion damage each turn to the affected model during its controller’s Maintenance Phase until it expires. Models with Resistance: Corrosion never suffer this continuous effect.

criticalDisruption.name: Critical Disruption
criticalDisruption.rules: On a critical hit on a warjack, the warjack suffers Disruption. A warjack suffering Disruption loses its focus points and cannot channel spells or gain focus by any means, including by being allocated focus, for one round.

disruption.name: Disruption
disruption.rules: A warjack hit by this attack loses its focus points and cannot channel spells or gain focus by any means, including by being allocated focus, for one round.

criticalCorrosion.name: Critical Corrosion
criticalCorrosion.rules:
On a critical hit, the model hit by this attack suffers the Corrosion continuous effect.

On a critical hit, the model hit suffers the Corrosion continuous effect.
